reasons: Both answers catch the missing notarial form, explain that the deal is void, and say the notary files Р13014, re-execute the sale and account for the money already paid. B misstates п. 12 ст. 21 14-ФЗ: under the current text the share passes when the entry is made in the ЕГРЮЛ, not when the deal is notarized. B builds its central end-of-month advice on that error ('the share will pass to you in September'), while A correctly says the share passes only when the ЕГРЮЛ entry is made.

B: Claims the share passes to the buyer when the deal is notarized (п. 12 ст. 21); under the current law it passes when the entry is made in the ЕГРЮЛ
